facts.fact_text: A demonstration was planned to be held on 20 October 2012 in Baku.
A demonstration was planned to be held on 17 November 2012 in Baku.
Each applicant attended one of the two demonstrations held on 20 October 2012 or 17 November 2012 in Baku (as specified in the Appendix).
According to the applicants, the demonstrations were intended to be peaceful.
According to the applicants, the demonstrations were conducted in a peaceful manner.
The Baku City Executive Authority refused to authorise the demonstration of 20 October 2012 at the place indicated by the organisers.
The Baku City Executive Authority refused to authorise the demonstration of 17 November 2012.
Shortly after the demonstrations had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
All applicants were arrested during the dispersal operations.
On 15 October 2012, prior to the assembly planned for 20 October 2012, the organisers, who were members of the opposition, gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority.
On 12 November 2012, prior to the assembly planned for 17 November 2012, the organisers, who were members of the opposition, gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority.
The Baku City Executive Authority refused to authorise the demonstration of 20 October 2012 at the place indicated by the organisers.
The Baku City Executive Authority refused to authorise the demonstration of 17 November 2012.
The Baku City Executive Authority noted in general terms that the assembly planned for 17 November 2012 would not be in accordance with the Law on Freedom of Assembly.
The Baku City Executive Authority noted that the square where the organisers proposed to hold the assembly planned for 17 November 2012 was a designated public leisure area.
The Baku City Executive Authority noted that the assembly planned for 17 November 2012 would be impractical.

The Baku City Executive Authority noted that the assembly planned for 17 November 2012 would be impractical.
Shortly after the demonstrations had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
All applicants were arrested during the dispersal operations.
The courts sentenced the applicants to a period of administrative detention varying from five to thirteen days (as specified in the Appendix).
According to the applicants, they were not given access to a lawyer after their arrest.
According to the applicants, they were not given access to a lawyer while they were in police custody.
